coordinateFrame: points ENH; poses and balls Three XYZ
scope: Actual mounted foundation-bearing shell, gate passage, inner court, collection, collection access, entry passage, whole ground, water, vegetation and every spatially partitioned road/ground dressing triangle. Union standard/calm; hero accepted only by equal actual geometry fingerprint.
limits: No eyes, renderer, shader or browser input test. This certificate is regenerated against actual currently mounted factory geometry.
DOM plates, atmosphere and shadow-only caster copies are excluded; all actual visible mesh solids including leaves and dressing are included.
The 0.25 m near distance, both authored viewport aspect ratios and maximum endpoint FOV are used.
Original linear routes and rounded proposals are reported separately.

The arrival continuous orientation proof supports a bounded look offset carried separately from the undragged pose slerp, including any look offset inside the full ±0.6 yaw / ±0.32 pitch rectangle at every instant. The proposed mounted rail must use that decomposition. Every other segment/fillet is covered at every orientation. Stored balls reserve 4 µm beyond the requested radius; runtime matching quantized geometry consumes at most 2 µm of it.

arrivalCertificate.method: Every original triangle intersecting the outer-edge near-ball capsule is separated by its vertical plane. Exact full-cone eye-to-near-pyramid standing support plus a conservative pi-slerp/YXZ derivative bound covers every continuous point toward or away from arrival; all remaining triangles are outside the enclosing capsule. The runtime reconstructed path must not be shorter than the certified rounded path, and the actual lens must never exceed the arrival lens.
